cards.card_text: A cherub A lion An eagle
cards.verse_text: He made two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat, one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.

cards.card_text: In David's song, the LORD mounts a cherub and flies, soaring on the wings of the wind.
cards.verse_text: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
cards.snippet: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.

cards.card_text: One wing touches the temple wall, and the other touches the ___ of the other cherub.
cards.verse_text: One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long and touched the wall of the temple, and its other wing was five cubits long and touched the wing of the other cherub.
cards.snippet: One wing of the first cherub was five cubits long and touched the wall of the temple, and…

cards.card_text: He parts the heavens, comes down, mounts a cherub and soars on the wings of the wind.
cards.verse_text: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
cards.snippet: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.

cards.card_text: Ezekiel looks again, and now he sees four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside each cherub.
cards.verse_text: Then I looked and saw four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside each cherub.
cards.snippet: …looked and saw four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside each cherub.

cards.card_text: Each of the cherubim has four faces: a cherub, a man and two more.
cards.verse_text: Each of the cherubim had four faces: the first face was that of a cherub, the second that of a man, the third that of a lion, and the fourth that of an eagle.
cards.snippet: …the cherubim had four faces: the first face was that of a cherub, the second that of a man, the third that of a lion,…

cards.card_text: A guardian cherub A high priest A prophet of God
cards.verse_text: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for I had ordained you.
cards.snippet: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for I had ordained you.

cards.card_text: Inside, the walls are paneled with wood and carved all around with cherubim and palm trees, each cherub with a man's face toward one palm tree and a young lion's face toward the other.
cards.verse_text: Each cherub had two faces: the face of a man was toward the palm tree on one side, and the face of a young lion was toward the palm tree on the other side.
